lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: I asked where the stolen evidence locker went.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: That was not one of the available directions.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: What is a direction but agreement with geometry?

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: North. South. Dock seven. Those are directions.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: You are developing a very dangerous attachment to that word.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Seek it without that particular syllable.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Better. Now where is the locker?

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: I regret teaching you another word.
